Israeli startup enso, which develops AI agent systems for marketing and sales, has raised $15 million in a Series A round led by MoreTech Ventures, with participation from existing investor NFX, Phenomen VC, and Gil Hirsch. The round brings the company’s total funding to $23 million. Full list of Israeli high-tech funding rounds in 2026 The new capital will be used to expand enso’s operations in what the company calls “Agentic Growth Hacking,” as businesses increasingly rely on AI tools to reach customers. The way companies reach customers is changing rapidly. Search algorithms, social media feeds and AI answer engines increasingly determine which businesses and products users encounter. Consumers and businesses are also turning to tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews to research companies and products alongside traditional search engines and social networks. That creates a moving target for marketers. Strategies that work today can lose their effectiveness as platforms change their algorithms, recommendation systems and rules, while user behavior evolves. Enso’s AI agents analyze how different platforms rank, recommend and cite content. They then test different approaches through small-scale experiments and measure the results. When an approach proves effective, enso can turn it into a repeatable growth mechanism for a customer. Tactics that stop working can be retested or abandoned. The company currently works with enterprises and startups including Papaya Global, MyHeritage, Papaya Gaming, Natural Intelligence, Winn AI and Israel Canada. For each customer, enso embeds an engineer and a marketer who connect the research to the company’s existing sales and marketing operations, systems and brand. The team builds a set of agents around those workflows and measures their performance against an established business and pipeline baseline. The systems operate across several channels, including search and AI-answer visibility, sales outreach, online communities, newsletters and social media. In AI search, for example, enso tracks which companies and sources are cited in answers to relevant questions and measures whether changes in content and distribution affect a customer’s visibility. Human oversight remains part of the system. Marketers determine strategy, brand boundaries and which playbooks are deployed, while the agents handle ongoing monitoring, testing and execution. Sensitive or irreversible actions remain under human control. Enso was founded in 2024 by Mickey Haslavsky, who serves as CEO and previously co-founded RapidAPI. Haslavsky coined the term “Agentic Growth Hacking” and is writing a book under the same title. The company employs 26 people, most of them based in Israel. enso publishes research on its experiments, including unsuccessful ones and the lessons learned from them, and maintains open-source reference skills for AI agents. “Marketing teams can spend months building a strategy around channels that change before they see results,” Haslavsky said. “AI agents make it possible to monitor multiple platforms continuously, test where opportunities are emerging and act while those opportunities still matter. We embed an engineer and a marketer with the customer, build the system around how they operate, measure against a baseline and keep a person accountable for what the agents do.”

products.name: enso AI agent systems
products.description: enso 的 AI 智能体分析不同平台如何排名、推荐和引用内容，通过小规模实验测试不同方法并衡量结果，将有效方法转化为可重复的增长机制。
features: 分析平台排名、推荐和引用内容
小规模实验测试并衡量结果
将有效方法转化为可重复的增长机制
跨搜索和 AI 答案可见性、销售外联、在线社区、通讯和社交媒体等渠道运营
为每个客户嵌入一名工程师和一名营销人员
围绕客户现有工作流构建智能体并对照基线衡量表现
保持人工监督，敏感或不可逆操作由人工控制

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是 AI 智能体在营销和销售增长场景中的持续实验与执行能力。enso 的已验证信号包括：已服务多家具名企业客户、累计融资达 2300 万美元、由 RapidAPI 联合创始人创立并拥有 26 人团队。但来源未披露本轮估值、收入或合同金额，也未提供投资机构公开投资逻辑，因此资本判断的证据边界仅限于融资事件、客户名单和产品描述。
